changes.to:
1. Open https://ticker.allomos.com/signin and enter your own email address.
2. Within a minute an email "Sign in to Ticker" arrives from no-reply@ticker.allomos.com
   (check the spam folder the first time).
3. Click "Sign in to Ticker" in the email, then "Sign in" on the page: you are signed in, with a
   list named Watchlist.
4. In Resend (resend.com, Emails), the sent email shows as delivered.
